fields.label: Splunk stack host:port
fields.description: Splunk Enterprise Security stack management endpoint, host and port only, e.g. splunk.example.com:8089 or stack123.splunkcloud.com:8089 -- no scheme (Crogl adds https://). 8089 is the default Splunk management port for both Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud; change only if an admin has customized the management port.

fields.label: Authentication token
fields.description: Splunk authentication token for a service account granted the mc_investigation_read, mc_risk_score_write, mc_assets_read, and mc_identity_read capabilities (or the blanket admin_all_objects). Generated under Settings -> Tokens. Injected server-side as the Authorization: Bearer header.

fields.label: Skip TLS verification
fields.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (for self-signed certs).
